providers.title: Projector geometry
providers.scope: The rank-one projections of R^k form a compact copy of projective space of diameter sqrt 2; distance sqrt 2 means orthogonal lines.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: From a cover to an admissible map
providers.scope: A cover of X_k by m sets of diameter less than sqrt 2 gives a smooth map to the simplex whose supports separate orthogonal lines.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sard's theorem
providers.scope: The critical values of a smooth map between Euclidean spaces form a null set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Regular level sets
providers.scope: The preimage of a regular value is a smooth submanifold of the expected dimension, with tangent space the kernel.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Local counting
providers.scope: If a map from a closed manifold is smooth with invertible derivative near the fibre of a point, the degree modulo two is the fibre size modulo two.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Homology of projective spaces modulo two
providers.scope: H_i(RP^n; F_2) = F_2 for 0 <= i <= n, with connecting isomorphisms in the transfer sequence of S^n -> RP^n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Odd self-maps of spheres
providers.scope: An odd continuous map S^n -> S^n has degree one modulo two.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Borsuk-Ulam theorem
providers.scope: There is no odd continuous map S^n -> S^d with d < n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Degree zero over a product (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A map L x RP^(h-1) -> RP^(a-1) induced by a map odd in the sphere variable has degree zero modulo two when dim L >= 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Square roots
providers.scope: Positive semidefinite square roots exist, are unique, continuous, and smooth on positive definite operators.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Positive extension (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The Gaussian average of an admissible map is continuous, has trace sum, the exact support of the range, and restricts to subspaces.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Odd extension (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The odd extension to symmetric operators has l1-norm the trace norm, exact sign supports, and is smooth at nonsingular operators.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Number of labels (OpenAI)
providers.scope: An admissible map on the lines of R^k needs at least k(k+1)/2 labels; at equality its extension has degree one and every pair is a face.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Supports at equality (OpenAI)
providers.scope: With k(k+1)/2 labels every facet has k labels and is hit an odd number of times over each regular value.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Simplicial and singular homology modulo two
providers.scope: For a finite simplicial complex the simplicial and singular homologies with F_2 coefficients agree.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Facet cycle (OpenAI)
providers.scope: At equality the sum of the facets is a cycle modulo two.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Six-label triangle systems
providers.scope: Links are five-cycles, no transposition preserves the system, and five labels determine it.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No ten labels on R^4 (OpenAI)
providers.scope: There is no admissible map from the lines of R^4 to the nine-dimensional simplex.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine (OpenAI)
providers.scope: X_4 has diameter sqrt 2 and cannot be covered by ten subsets of smaller diameter.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: All dimensions from nine
providers.scope: For every d >= 9 a compact subset of R^d needs more than d+1 pieces of smaller diameter.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
